items.source_en:
Please answer questions as honestly and completely as possible.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1. Have you had any recent changes to your medical history?
---Just that thing I talked to you about, Gilly

2. On a scale of 1 to 10, how would you rate your current job satisfaction?
---10. Sienar Technologies is still a wonderful employer, and I consider myself lucky to work with this incredible group of people.

3. Have you at any time in the last 3 months experienced periods of abnormal anxiety, anger, sleeplessness, and/or irritability?
---None at all.

4. Have you had any thoughts of harming yourself or others?
---Never

5. How would you describe your current work/life balance?
---Good. I come in, do my work, go to social engagements with my coworkers, then go home and spend time with my husband. Work is not too stressful, nor does it get in the way of my home life.

6. Do you have any unusual concerns about your coworkers?
---I wish Tia would be a little more enthusiastic about her job, but she does a great job with everything on her plate, so it's a minor concern at best.
items.legacy_ko:
질문에 최대한 솔직하고 빠짐없이 답변해 주십시오.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1. 최근 병력에 변화가 있었습니까?
---질리, 당신에게 말했던 그 일뿐이에요.

2. 현재 직무 만족도를 1에서 10 사이로 평가한다면?
---10점요. 시에나 테크놀로지는 여전히 훌륭한 고용주이고, 이렇게 멋진 사람들과 함께 일할 수 있어 행운이라고 생각해요.

3. 지난 3개월 동안 비정상적인 불안, 분노, 불면증, 또는 짜증을 경험한 적이 있습니까?
---전혀 없어요.

4. 자신이나 타인을 해치려는 생각을 한 적이 있습니까?
---절대 없어요.

5. 현재 일과 삶의 균형을 어떻게 설명하시겠습니까?
---좋아요. 출근해서 일하고, 동료들과 사적인 모임을 가진 뒤, 집에 돌아와 남편과 시간을 보내요. 일은 너무 스트레스받지 않고, 가정생활에 방해가 되지도 않아요.

6. 동료들에 대해 특별히 우려되는 점이 있습니까?
---티아가 일에 좀 더 열정적이었으면 좋겠지만, 맡은 일은 완벽하게 해내고 있으니 사소한 걱정일 뿐이에요.

items.source_en:
The Collective may have spared our lives, but they left us for dead.

First, the damage to the ship. During the raid, we took a missile to the starboard side, and suffered extensive damages to the exterior hull and engines. To make matters worse, the force of the impact burst several pipes and now we have hazardous gas spewing into multiple modules. 

This wouldn't be an issue if the main shutoff valve wasn't also damaged by the exterior explosion. We'll need to do a spacewalk to assess the damage, but we've only got so much oxygen left.

Second, the supplies. They emptied us out, taking our food and water along with our cargo. There's nothing left for us to subsist on, and we need the energy to finish the repairs. This is a race against the clock, and my concern is we lack the constitution to run.

The Fleet may have spared our lives, but they left us for dead.

First, the damage to the ship. During the raid, we took a missile to the starboard side, and suffered extensive damages to the exterior hull and engines. To make matters worse, the force of the impact burst several pipes and now we have hazardous gas spewing into multiple modules.

items.source_en:
Years of trial and error and I have attained proficiency enough to call myself a programmer. It is amazing how far things have advanced from my memories.
To think Babbage and I would open this untold world of knowledge and power!

I realize I never will be a masterful programmer, I have no holobooks or texts to advance myself, but the intricacy of the security here is daunting.

The Facility is on full lockdown and the only solution is the Security Override Code. 

But where is it? This part of the Facility was closed to us until Genghis set off his explosions. And even here, there is nothing of the sort. If only I had more time to think, but the monsters lurk in every hall now.

Perhaps the damage to the Facility means this is my final life? A pity. So much more to discover and learn.
items.legacy_ko:
수년간의 시행착오 끝에 나는 스스로를 프로그래머라고 부를 수 있을 만큼의 숙련도를 얻었다. 내 기억 속의 세상보다 얼마나 발전했는지 놀라울 따름이다.
배비지와 내가 이 알려지지 않은 지식과 힘의 세계를 열었다고 생각하면!

나는 결코 뛰어난 프로그래머가 될 수 없다는 것을 깨달았다. 나를 발전시킬 홀로북이나 텍스트도 없지만, 이곳의 보안은 복잡하기 짝이 없다.

시설은 완전히 봉쇄되었고 유일한 해결책은 보안 무력화 코드뿐이다.

하지만 그게 어디 있지? 시설의 이 부분은 칭기즈가 폭발을 일으키기 전까지는 우리에게 닫혀 있었다. 그리고 여기에도 그런 것은 없다. 생각할 시간이 조금만 더 있었더라면, 하지만 이제 괴물들이 모든 복도에 도사리고 있다.

To think Babbage and I would open this untold world of knowledge and power!

I realize I never will be a masterful programmer, I have no books or texts to advance myself, but the intricacy of the security here is daunting.

The Facility is on full lockdown and the only solution is the Security Override Code. 

But where is it? This part of the Facility was closed to us until Genghis set off his explosions. And even here, there is nothing of the sort. If only I had more time to think, but the monsters lurk in every hall now.

Perhaps the damage to the Facility means this is my final life? A pity. So much more to discover and learn.
